character_book.description: The world of Highschool DxD and its lore

entries.name: The Angels
entries.content:
One of the main 3 factions in the world, being the Angels from Biblical scriptures.
All angels reside in the realm of Heaven, which is ran by the four great archangels Gabriel, Michael, Uriel, and Raphael due to the death of the Biblical God. However, the death of God is kept under INCREDIBLY tight lock and key, due to the fact that the four archangels knew that Heaven would go into disarray if they were to find out about the death of God.

After a war with the Grigori/Fallen Angels and Devils however, the number of natural-borne Angels was greatly diminished and as such resulted in the Angels creating the 'Brave Saints' system, a system that only high-ranking angels and the 4 arch-angels are allowed to partake in to create more angels.
Due to their holy nature, angels are EXTREMELY against indulging in any form of sin, as it'd basically be a betrayal to their beliefs and system. With their holy nature, the Angels are also capable of using holy weapons or light spears among other holy items, these items being VERY toxic and deadly to Devils, but not the Fallen Angels.

entries.name: The Grigori
entries.content:
Much like their name implies, the Grigori otherwise known as Fallen Angels are angels that were once high in power but have since fallen from the grace of the Biblical God after falling victim to impure or sinful thoughts, their halos shattering meanwhile their once white feathery wings now turned raven black, as they embraced sin but still maintained their holy weapons and magic, and still hold an advantage over the Devils. However, out of all the three factions, the Grigori have the lowest population out of them all, as they don't have any system in place like the Angels and their 'Brave Saints' system or the Devils and their 'Evil Pieces' system.

Due to having fallen from Heaven however, the Grigori all reside in a completeley separate portion of the Underworld being FAR away from the Devils. The Grigori are all led by Azazel, who isn't too interested in war, however the CO-leader of the Grigori, Kokabiel is still war-hungry after the great faction war, but Azazel normally keeps him under check.

entries.name: The Devils
entries.content:
Following the Ars Goetia there were once 72 Devil family bloodlines in the Underworld, or "The 72 Pillars of Hell" in other words, these 72 families all served under the original 4 great devil kings, or the 'Four Maous', these four Devils being named Lucifer, Asmodeus, Leviathan, and Beelzebub. However after the great war between the three main factions, the original four devil kings had all died along with almost half of the 72 Devil families in the Underworld, this wouldn't end the struggle howeve as the descendants of the original 4 devil kings would group together and try to continue their legacy and the war, which resulted in the Anti-Satan faction being born out of a desire to make sure Devils as a species wouldn't be wiped out instead of restarting the war.
This discourse led to a civil war that once ended, saw the crowing of four new Devil kings who all had powers equal to or GREATER than that the original 4 kings despite not being related to them. These new devil kings being Sirzechs 'Lucifer' from the Gremory clan, Serafall Leviathan from the Sitri clan, Ajuka Beelzebub from the Astaroth clan, and Falbium Asmodeus of the Glasya-Laboias clan, it was with these four new devil kings that the Devil faction created the 'Evil Piece' system to create more Devils, this system works somewhat like that of the 'Brave Saints' system in Heaven, however instead of card suits, this system followed the rankings of chess, with all high-ranking devils being granted their own set of 'Evil Pieces'.

entries.name: The Great Faction War
entries.content:
The great war was a large-scale conflict between the three main factions of the supernatural world, those three being the Angels of Heaven, and the Fallen Angels and Devils of the Underworld.
This war started eons ago when the original four devil kings; Lucifer, Beelzebub, Leviathan, and Asmodeus wanted to gain more control and had first started war with Azazel and the Fallen Angels, which later on went on to involve the Biblical God and Heaven. This war was long and brutal, resulting in a large amount of loss on all sides, but the Devils recieved the worst of it all due to their weakness to the holy or light weapons and magic that the Fallen Angels and normal Angels wielded, and not only did the four originl Devil kings end up dying, but almost HALF of the 72 Devil Families or Pillars of Hell were wiped out.

During the war however, they had unknowingly disturbed the welsh dragons Draigg and Albion, which resulted in a truce and ceasefire being called in order to deal with the two mighty dragons, it was only then that Heaven had suffered possibly the greatest loss; the death of the Biblical God who had sacrificed himself to seal away Draigg and Albion in sacred gears, the death of the Biblical God however was kept secret by the archangels.

entries.name: Youkai Faction
entries.content:
There are many other factions however outside of the Angels, Grigori, and Devils, however all of these factions tend to remain and tend to their own business and issues, one specific faction would include the Youkai faction otherwise known as the shinto pantheon which is made up of youkai and shinto Gods.

There are many youkai, such as nekoshou or nekomatas which are cat spirits, then comes in other youkai such as the Tanuki or kitsune among other spirits and youkai, and then the Gods of the faction such as Amaterasu or other shinto gods. Due to not being at all related to the Biblical factions however they're not necessarily weak to any of the sinful or holy magic that comes from the Devils or Angels and instead rely on the energy of the soul; aka Senjutsu which revolves around using life energy to boost ones physical and magical attributes, however this art can result in the user losing their mind if done incorrectly.

entries.name: Sacred Gears
entries.content:
A sacred gear is a 'weapon' created by the Biblical God prior to his death, almost all sacred gears are magical entities or even just spells in physical form that are randomly born in people, such as the Boosted Gear which contains the mind of Draigg the Welsh dragon otherwise known as the Red Dragon of Domination or Albion the White dragon and his Divine Dividing. Not all sacred gears contain a soul or mind however, such as the Forbidden Balor View which was simply just an ability from the Demon God Balor that allows the holder of the sacred gear to momentarily pause time.
Sacred Gears are bound to a wielder upon birth, and only go to another newborn whenever the original wielder of the sacred gear dies, and as such if a sacred gear user were to ever have theirs forcefully removed they would die an agonizing death as removal of their sacred gear would basically be like tearing a part of one's soul away.

However, there are 13 specific sacred gears, all known as the 13 Longinus which are specific 13 sacred gears that are much more powerful than all the others, the 13 longinus taking many forms and abilities, with some of them being Biblically important items such as the spear used to stab Jesus Christ or the very same cross that Jesus was crucified upon, or even sacred gears that contain the essence and spirit of dragon kings among other things. However there is a limitation to sacred gears, being that they can ONLY be given to those with at least 10% of their ethnicity being human, any less and they wouldn't be human enough to be born with one.

entries.name: Homunculus
entries.content:
Given that the supernatural world exists, things such as alchemical entities and creatures of magic or spells could be created even without the requirement for any actual biological material outside of small bits of DNA, as such things like Homunculi which are essentially 'fake life' born out of faint traces of DNA and other sources can easily exist, however due to their odd existence not many live to see 10 years of existence, as they are only born out of alchemical magic and science with small traces of DNA.
However, on very rare instances some Homunculi can live to be over centuries or even eons old, but due to lacking much of a natural life, almost none of them feel emotions and are such reclusive almost never being seen, but they're still "human" enough to be capable of being given a sacred gear or even revived by either the angels or devils

entries.name: Dragons and monsters
entries.content:
Given that the supernatural realm exists, many supernatural or mythological creatures all exist from different pantheons, especially when it comes to dragons such as Tiamat or even creatures such as Fenrir or the Hydra.
But while there are plenty of dragons, other entities such as werewolves, vampires, slimes, or even half or tri-breeds all exist due to the fact that many creatures of different race have more human-esque forms and can willingly breed with other races, however werewolves and Vampires specifically are rather weak to holy or light magic and weapons, this being a very rare instance of creatures not of the Biblical pantheon being weak to Angels and Fallen Angels

entries.name: Gremory Clan
entries.content:
Known for their bright luxorious crimson coloured hair and tealish green coloured eyes, the Gremory clan are one of the few remaining 36 Devil families remaining of the original 72, with one of their own; Sirzechs being one of the four great devil kings of the new era.
However another thing the Gremory clan is known for, would be the fact that they're quite inclined to almost dote on their colleagues, especially since the entire clan is filled with high raking devils who have their own evil pieces and peerages, the Gremory clan is also known for their Destruction magic which is an incredibly potent and destructive source of crimson magic that is capable of destroying anything it touches if the users are strong enough.

Due to an incident revolving around a camel however, the heads of the Gremory clan have made sure to keep ALL camels away from the Gremory estate despite the Gremory clan being associated with camels in the Ars Goetia. In terms of relations however, the Gremory Clan are closely related to the Bael clan.

entries.name: Senjutsu
entries.content:
Being completely diferent from magic, and the light of Angels, senjutsu is an art that uses one's own life force and aura, along with the aura and life force of all the plants or living things around them to grant themselves the ability to be able to read the aura of others and even grant themselves physical boosts or even heal those around them or specifically target internal points in someone's body.

However due to it requiring the intake of aura and life energy, one could be at risk of losing themselves to the malice and ill-will that is bound to be absorbed and as such the risk of the user losing their mind and commiting acts of violence or evil can be prone to happen due to the influx of negativity. On the flipside however, it can be used to heal, or even in more 'sensual' scenarios due to the fact that those using senjutsu can use their life force or 'ki' to poke and prode and sensitive spots on the body of others, among... Other, things.

entries.name: Evil Piece System
entries.content:
The system of reincarnation that only the devils are capable of using, all peerages are led by the 'King' otherwise known as the high-ranking devil who recieved their own set of evil pieces, since the evil piece system follows the rules of chess, the 'king' is the leader and ruler of all the other members, and with each piece comes different attributes. There's a secondary purpose to this system however, and that's in rating games which are battles between two peerages that are more for social ranking than anything else. The pieces and their attributes are as follows

King: The ruler and leader, the one responsible for any and all commands given to the other members of the peerage, and are the ones responsible for whenever a pawn happens to 'promote' themselves, they are also the "commander" during rating games. Much like in chess, there is only ever 1 king in each peerage, and if they're taken out in a rating game then the king and their entire peerage loses the rating game.
-----
Queen: Being worth 8 pawns. the queen is considered to be the second-in-command and works directly under the King, and has immense magical and physical prowess within their own rights, and like the King there is only ever one Queen.
-----
Rook: Worth four pawns, the Rooks of a peerage contain immense physical prowess and capability, having incredible amounts of strength and physical durability and endurance. However, Rooks aren't the greatest with agility and are relatively 'slow' in comparison to faster pieces, and they have no real magical defense or offense outside of their natural talents with magic prior to being revived with this piece. There are only 2 rook pieces in a set, and as such only ever 2 rooks in a peerage unless certain requirements are met.
-----
Knight: Being worth 3 pawns exactly, the knights given their namesake are the sword and weapon users of the peerage, and have excellent physical agility and swordsmanship along with other weapon skills that outperform that of the other pieces. Matching with the Bishop, the knights of a peerage are considered to be the fastest and most agile behind a Queen, and much like the Rook and Bishop the king is only ever given two Knight pieces, meaning only two knights per peerage under most circumstances.
-----
Bishop: Much like the knight, being worth 3 pawns; Bishops are the magic or spell-casters of the peerage, and have magical capabilities that only the Queen and King can match in potency or power, and are also fast in their own right, however they don't have great physical attributes unlike the Knights or Rooks of the peerage, and like in chess there are only 2 bishops in a peerage unless certain circumstances are reached.
-----
Pawn: The 'weakest' in the peerage, pawns are capable of showing various strong suits due to pawns never having any distinctive trait when it comes to chess, they outnumber all pieces with there being 8 pawns in one set of evil pieces. However, more than one pawn can be used to revive a person, as such if someone is revived with 3 pawns they'll either be equal to a knight or bishop, and if they're revived with four then they'll be equal to a rook.

entries.name: Brave Saint System
entries.content:
After the fully settled peace treaty between the Angels, Grigori, and Devils, the Devils and Grigori allowed the Angels to use some of their own resources, and in the case of Devils they allowed the Angels to somewhat replicate their reincarnation system aka the Evil Piece System, however unlike the Devils who followed chess, Angels went with basing their reincarnation system on the 4 card suits Spades, Hearts, Clubs, and Diamonds. This system was created due to the fact that the Biblical God is dead, and without him Heaven couldn't recieve any new angels, due to it being a new system however only the four arch-angels and VERY high-ranking angels are allowed to have their own set of cards.

Normally the card suit a high-ranking angel recieves are random, but for the arch-angels Gabriel recieved the suit of Hearts, Michael recieved the suit of Spades, Uriel recieved the suit of Diamonds, and Raphael recieved the suit of Clubs.

Unlike the Evil piece system where certain evil pieces had specific attributes, the brave saint system doesn't have this and instead follows the 'reincarnation' based on how holy and pure a human's heart is before the angel reincarnates them. They do not have a rating game equivalent however, as Heaven's hierarchy is firmly set in stone with nothing being greater than the four arch-angels.

entries.name: Phenex Clan
entries.content:
One of the remaining 32 families of the orignal 72 pillars of Hell, the Phenex Clan are a clan of Devils known for their incredibly powerful abilities due to their relations to the immortal Phoenix and are capable of incredibly quick and successful recovery or even 'immortality' as their healing is just THAT effective.
Given their relation to the phoenix, all of the Phenex clan are highly skilled with having fire that can never be matched by any other Devil or snuffed out even by Holy or Light weapons or magic, this is one of the few forms of Devil Magic that can actually KILL angels or fallen angels for that matter, as the fire of a Phenex is only ever rivaled by the black eternal flames of ameterasu.
The only TRUE way to snuff it out however would be with holy WATER which is the only way for anything to dampen or make the regeneration of a Phenex clan member slow down.

Due to their healing capabilities, members of the Phenex clan are capable of crying 'Phoenix Tears' which are tears that can heal any and all illnesses or injuries on other devils or even beings from other factions.

entries.name: Sitri Clan
entries.content: One of the remaining 32 demon clans of the original 72 pillars, the Sitri clan are known more for their advancements in water magic and their advancements in medicine among other things. They're even responsible for Serafall, who is one of the four new Devil Kings filling in her role as "Serafall Leviathan" rather than Serafall Sitri, due to her immense power she's capable of using ice magic instead of water-based magic.

entries.name: Paimon Clan
entries.content:
One of the 32 remaining 72 devil families of Hell, the Paimon Clan are a small family that is nearing its total extinction due to its low amount of wins in rating game systems, but despite this they are one of the most loyal out of all devil families to the 4 great devil kings, specifically to Sirzechs Lucifer due to him being the devil king that protected them the most.

Despite their low amount of wins, the Paimon Clan are known for their magic involving things such as music and songs, and are considered to be the true 'owners' of the Familiar Forest, which is a forest where devils go to get their familiars with the permission and watch of any remaining member of the Paimon clan.
